title: Pocketwire Rewards Engaged-Spender Rate Schedule for Gift Cards
content:
Pocketwire Rewards members with strong recent card spend and at least one whole year of membership receive the gift card engaged-spender lift on the rate at which their points are valued for a gift card.

## Rule

The gift card engaged-spender lift is 0.15 US cents per point when the gift card spend measure is at least 13000 USD and the membership has completed at least 3 whole years; it is 0.05 cents per point when the member does not meet that first condition but the gift card spend measure is at least 8000 USD and the membership has completed at least 1 whole year; and it is nothing otherwise.

The lift is added to the gift card rate per point before the rate is applied to the points redeemed.

## Definitions

- The gift card spend measure is the spend carried by earning entries dated within the last three months less the spend carried by clawback entries dated within the same three months.
- Earning entries are the entries that credit base and category points on a card purchase; boost entries, which carry the same purchase's spend, are not earning entries.
- A date lies within the last three months when it is later than the same calendar day three months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.
- The membership's whole years are the whole months from the enrolment date to the handling date divided by twelve and rounded down.

## Lift by spend and years

| Gift card spend measure | Whole years of membership | Lift (cents per point) |
|---|---|---|
| 13000 USD or more | 3 or more | 0.15 |
| 13000 USD or more | 1 or 2 | 0.05 |
| 8000 USD or more, below 13000 USD | 1 or more | 0.05 |
| 8000 USD or more | 0 | nothing |
| below 8000 USD | any | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A spend measure of 13000.00 USD exactly and 3 whole years: 0.15 cents per point. On a tier whose gift card value per point is 1.10 cents, the rate becomes 1.25 cents.
- A spend measure of 14200.00 USD with 2 whole years: the first condition fails on years; the lift is 0.05 cents per point.
- Earning entries of 9100.00 USD and a clawback entry of 1200.00 USD in the window give a spend measure of 7900.00 USD: nothing.
